objectives.text: Replace a dependency with a hand-written fake that works in memory
Write a stub that returns canned answers for a test
Explain why depending on an interface makes a class testable

minutes.basis: Measured on 2026-11-08 from the final artifact bytes. modeledP50: p50 of authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py on the current artifact.html. modeledWorstPath: modeledP50 plus 2.0 minutes for the worst required route (the wrong-twice route): reading the feedback on a wrong prediction (0.5), one extra failing run in each of the stub and fake editors with Problems and Output read (0.5 each), and the wrong-first testability choice retried (0.5). aboutLabel and budget equal the page's own about label, which is at least ceil(max(modeledP50, modeledWorstPath)) and within the 15 minute ceiling.

unverifiedItems: Sources were fetched live by the implementation owner on 2026-11-08 (HTTP status, final URL and hash in sourcesRef); no independent SME critic re-verified the claims under the minimum acceptance profile.
